Fields.Name: Circle Map Edge Margin Rate
Fields.Description: A new circle position is rejected unless its centre lies at least (radius x this) inside the edge of the 1024 m play map, so 0.5 keeps at least half of the circle on the map. Retail: 0.7 (row 0), 0.5 (rows 1 and 2).

Fields.Name: Circle Max Shrink Speed
Fields.Description: Maximum average speed (m per second of real time) at which the circle edge may move during a phase: a new circle whose centre shift plus radius change, divided by the phase length, exceeds this is rejected, and the phase's circle radius is bounded by it. Retail: 7 (row 0), 16 (rows 1 and 2).

Fields.Name: Divine Tower Second Circle Radius
Fields.Description: Second circle radius in metres for Divine Tower play areas (PlayAreaCreateParam 12000-12999), used instead of Second Circle Radius; in one game state it is also the minimum radius of the inside-the-circle check. Values below 20 use 51. Only row 2 is read. Retail: 51 (rows 0 and 2), 40 (row 1).

Fields.Name: Initial Circle: Map ID: AA
Fields.Description: The AA part of the MSB that this targets.

Fields.Name: Initial Circle: Map ID: BB
Fields.Description: The BB part of the MSB that this targets.

Fields.Name: Initial Circle: Map ID: CC
Fields.Description: The CC part of the MSB that this targets.

Fields.Name: Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag ID read when the map pattern is set up. Retail: 7506 (Day 2 preliminary battle has started) on row 0, 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Night Boss Day 1 Site Define ID
Fields.Description: SmallBaseAndSpotDefine row for the Day 1 Night Boss: when a site's map is in this row's map list, the site gets this row. Checked after the regular site defines. 0: none. Retail: 108 (row 0), 2108 (row 1), 0 (row 2).

Fields.Name: Night Boss Day 2 Site Define ID
Fields.Description: As Night Boss Day 1 Site Define ID, for the Day 2 Night Boss; checked when the Day 1 row does not match. Retail: 109 (row 0), 2109 (row 1), 0 (row 2).
